mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations and reduces risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 305 indicates persistent inflation, triggering central bank tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 305, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (above 0.1% monthly change) and fall in UNRATE (below -0.1% monthly change) signals aggressive monetary policy and a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with tight labor market
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS up >0.1% and UNRATE down >0.1%) fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings remain robust.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% indicates a tight labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth remains strong.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a falling housing starts (HOUST) signals underlying economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (INDPRO up >0.1% and HOUST down >0.1%) fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a demand-driven expansion regime (indicated by rising RSAFS and rising HOUST), the S&P 500 produces positive returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and housing activity support economic growth.
failure_condition: In the demand-driven expansion regime (RSAFS and HOUST both rising >0.1%), SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) reading below 1350 indicates a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1350, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.
